actions.reason: _breakpoint_report: (1) When no symbol-prefix filter applies, every location of a breakpoint counts. The whole count is now added up front, and the loop exits as soon as MAX_REPORTED_LOCATIONS are retained. This removes the per-location prefix/full checks and count increments on that path. The remaining byte budget is tracked directly instead of being recomputed from retained bytes on each iteration. (2) A new helper, _report_location_sizes, computes the estimated and exact JSON sizes of a newly resolved _location dict in one pass over its five values. It starts from precomputed constants for the fixed keys. Non-str/None values fall back to the existing generic functions. The exact size is still None when the estimate exceeds MAX_BREAKPOINT_LOCATION_BYTES. Counts, retained locations, truncation flags and sizes are unchanged; equivalence outputs are identical. Measured report_ir ratio 0.9590; hits_ir unchanged (0.9998).
